{{Quote|Lieutenant Needa, liaison officer.|Needa|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Needa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he was stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in the [[Toxic Lake Garrison]].
